recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It completes the stale-reference cleanup requested by FHIR-25215 while avoiding unrelated changes to Encounter.reason/diagnosis policy or historical release snapshots.
issue_request: FHIR-25215 was Published/Persuasive for Encounter after the reporter found Encounter reason comments that still referred to the removed primaryDiagnosis extension. The approved resolution said the comment referencing the deleted extension would be removed.
initial_application: Commit 77aea6c901f0f26c0970d5f9fe5f7c0b2325bb69 previously removed the two primaryDiagnosis comments from source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml. Current Encounter definitions no longer contain those comments, but source/encounter/list-Encounter-examples.xml still described Encounter/f202 as having the primaryDiagnosis extension added.
additional_context: FHIR-14758 and commit c1e9ac08c9a38245635a59eea66e8ef8b837f3a3 show the earlier decision to remove the redundant encounter-primaryDiagnosis extension and update example f202 to demonstrate principal-diagnosis usage without that extension. PA minutes on Confluence record the FHIR-25215 persuasive vote. The Encounter resource is active in source/fhir.ini, and the examples list is current Encounter source; searches of current Encounter source and the FHIR Extension Pack found no current encounter-primaryDiagnosis definition.
reconciliation: Changed source/encounter/list-Encounter-examples.xml so the f202 description is the generic 'Real-world encounter example' instead of saying the removed primaryDiagnosis extension was added.
